summary: Focused testing of the new 20-mile delivery-zone feature (backend + frontend) plus light regression. Backend: 19/19 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_delivery_zone.py (GET /api/settings delivery block, /api/delivery/check for in-zone/out-of-zone/invalid/missing/center ZIP, POST /api/orders zone enforcement with stock-integrity check, PayPal create-order pre-flight zone gate, admin settings GET/PUT validation + radius change effect + restore). Frontend: home banner + ZIP checker, checkout out-of-zone gating and successful Zelle order, admin Store Settings delivery fields save/persist/restore, cart PUFF10 promo + tax regression. No blocking defects found.

minor.issue: deliveryDistanceMiles is persisted on the order document but not returned by order_response(); order confirmation/admin cannot show the computed distance.
No dedicated 400 for missing/blank zip - returns 200 with eligible:false + 'Please enter a valid 5-digit US ZIP code.' (acceptable for UI, noting for API consumers).

issues: During the auto-advance transition two slide headlines/subtitles render stacked on top of each other for ~1s (see mid-transition screenshot); crossfade should fully hide the outgoing slide text (pre-existing, unrelated to delivery zone).

State dropdown values are full state names ('Florida') while the ZIP lookup returns the 2-letter code ('FL'); order 'Delivering to' shows 'Orlando, Florida 32801'. Inconsistent but cosmetic; also broke a naive test using 'FL'.

action_items: Optional: expose deliveryDistanceMiles in order_response() so the order confirmation/admin order view can show the computed distance.
Optional: align checkout State select values with 2-letter codes to match ZIP lookup output.
Optional: fix hero slider crossfade text overlap during transition.
critical_code_review_comments: delivery_zone_check/require_delivery_zone are correctly invoked before reserve_stock in create_order and before any PayPal HTTP call in paypal_create_order - verified server-side that no stock is decremented and PayPal is never contacted for out-of-zone ZIPs.

StoreSettingsInput validates deliveryZip via zipcodes lookup (00000 -> 422) and radius bounds (0 -> 422); _settings_cache is invalidated on PUT so /api/settings and /api/delivery/check reflect changes immediately - verified live.
get_settings()/admin settings responses exclude MongoDB _id - verified.
Added missing data-testid attributes (age-gate-yes / age-gate-no) to AgeGate.jsx for automation; no functional change.
seed_data_creation: Created 5 transient orders (zelle/test_card, ZIP 32801) via API/UI; all deleted afterwards and product stock incremented back. Admin store settings verified restored to taxRate 0.065 / deliveryFee 15 / freeDeliveryMin 99 / deliveryZip 32832 / deliveryRadiusMiles 20 (confirmed via GET /api/settings and /api/delivery/check?zip=32801 -> eligible true, 15.8 mi).
test_credentials: admin@puff2door.com / Puff2Door-Admin1 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md); note login redirects to '/' (home) rather than staying on /my-account, admin nav link appears correctly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Delivery-zone feature is fully verified end-to-end. Reusable suite: /app/backend/tests/test_delivery_zone.py (run with `python -m pytest tests/test_delivery_zone.py -p xdist -n 0` from /app/backend; pytest.ini forces xdist args). Gotchas: CartItem requires productId(int)+name+price, checkout State select values are full state names ('Florida'), age gate has data-testid age-gate-yes, after login the app redirects to '/'. Cart pricing endpoint is /api/promo/validate (no /api/cart/price). Test orders should be cleaned up from db.orders with stock re-increment.
rca_of_the_issue: No defects requiring RCA. Two initial test failures were test-authoring issues (wrong cart item payload shape and 'FL' vs 'Florida' select value), not application bugs; the third (deliveryDistanceMiles absent from the order response) is a real but minor omission in order_response().
